edits.after: Someone initially works hard to gain room for choice. Yet after their income rises, they are even more afraid to stop because they must maintain an image of success. They originally wanted their work to be seen, but later they only dare repeat forms already recognized. Every step still counts as progress, while the original reason finds less and less room in decisions.
edits.reason: Naturalize dare stop even less while retaining the contrast between gaining room for choice and becoming afraid to stop.

edits.after: What is hardest for us to see is often not minor mistakes along the path but what the path is excluding.
edits.reason: Repair the awkward hardest to see ourselves construction; the difficulty is our own seeing, not seeing ourselves as an object.
edits.before: What is hardest to see ourselves is often not minor mistakes along the path but what the path is excluding.

edits.after: Un rumbo verdaderamente sólido no es aquel al que ninguna pregunta puede afectar, sino el que puede explicar de nuevo por qué continúa después de ser cuestionado. Si hace falta, también puede cambiar de forma o admitir que una vieja respuesta ya ha cumplido su recorrido.
edits.reason: Clarify the negative scope: stability is not immunity from all questions, but being able to answer them and reconsider.
edits.before: Un rumbo verdaderamente sólido no es intocable por cualquier pregunta, sino capaz de explicar de nuevo por qué continúa después de ser cuestionado. Si hace falta, también puede cambiar de forma o admitir que una vieja respuesta ya ha cumplido su recorrido.

edits.after: A value that is truly your own does not need to be proved by turning other people into copies of you.
edits.reason: Naturalize the mixed reflexive reproducing oneself and make clear that the issue is imposing one's pattern on others, not literal reproduction.
edits.before: A value that is truly one's own need not prove itself by reproducing oneself.

edits.after: A veces el cambio va más allá de la forma. La acción revela que también debe profundizarse la comprensión inicial del valor. Quien busca libertad empieza a ver la responsabilidad; quien quiere ayudar aprende a retroceder; quien quiere crear descubre que la obra no se reduce a la expresión personal.
edits.reason: A work is not limited to self-expression; it does not literally belong to self-expression. Retain all three examples of deepening value.

review_scope.method: Read every Chinese, English and Spanish paragraph from the formal incoming ZIP, comparing meaning, argument, examples and qualifications; checked paragraph alignment against supplied Markdown. Local edits preserve paragraph positions and complete argument.
